description: This file defines the AdminManager class, which manages administrative user operations such as sign-in, sign-out, retrieving admin details, and listing users within a library management system.

classes.name: AdminManager
classes.description: A class that manages administrative user operations such as sign-in, sign-out, retrieving admin details, and listing users.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AdminManager with a DAO object, setting up admin, user, and dao references.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Authenticates an admin user by email and password, returning admin info if successful.

methods.name: getUsersList
methods.description: Returns a list of users and prints it.

methods.name: signout
methods.description: Signs out the current admin user.
